title: Fixing staleness closes only part of the problem
axis: Deadline for every copy to update

segments.label: While the request waits
segments.governed_by: What the system does before it decides
segments.observation: Review first: all 73 promotional-outreach probes were still permitted. Restrict in the meantime: none were. Probes test permission only; the prototype sends no email.

segments.label: Allowed update window
segments.governed_by: How long cached permissions may live (the staleness budget)
segments.observation: With a strict lease, 254 outdated grants fell inside the window the budget allows.

segments.label: After the deadline
segments.governed_by: Whether the update mechanism is correct
segments.observation: A correctly sized strict lease, or a revision check: 0 outdated grants after the deadline. Push-only updates: 172. Long cache lifetime: 2,738.

side_tracks.label: A path nobody checked
side_tracks.governed_by: What the evidence says it covered
side_tracks.observation: A secondary lookup path honored outdated permissions in 5 of 5 probes, while evidence for the main path reported zero errors.

side_tracks.label: Already shared
side_tracks.observation: Encryption protects future values. Anything already shared under the old key can still be read.

caption: A correct staleness fix closes the third segment. The other exposure points each need their own remedy, which is why an evidence record has to say what it did not check.
